class ChatInput(ChatComponent):
    display_name = "Chat Input"
    description = "Get chat inputs from the Playground."
    documentation: str = "https://docs.langflow.org/chat-input-and-output"
    icon = "MessagesSquare"
    name = "ChatInput"
    minimized = True

    inputs = [
        MultilineInput(
            name="input_value",
            display_name="Input Text",
            value="",
            info="Message to be passed as input.",
            input_types=[],
        ),
        BoolInput(
            name="should_store_message",
            display_name="Store Messages",
            info="Store the message in the history.",
            value=True,
            advanced=True,
        ),
        DropdownInput(
            name="sender",
            display_name="Sender Type",
            options=[MESSAGE_SENDER_AI, MESSAGE_SENDER_USER],
            value=MESSAGE_SENDER_USER,
            info="Type of sender.",
            advanced=True,
        ),
        MessageTextInput(
            name="sender_name",
            display_name="Sender Name",
            info="Name of the sender.",
            value=MESSAGE_SENDER_NAME_USER,
            advanced=True,
        ),
        MessageTextInput(
            name="session_id",
            display_name="Session ID",
            info="The session ID of the chat. If empty, the current session ID parameter will be used.",
            advanced=True,
        ),
        MessageTextInput(
            name="context_id",
            display_name="Context ID",
            info="The context ID of the chat. Adds an extra layer to the local memory.",
            value="",
            advanced=True,
        ),
        FileInput(
            name="files",
            display_name="Files",
            file_types=TEXT_FILE_TYPES + IMG_FILE_TYPES,
            info="Files to be sent with the message.",
            advanced=True,
            is_list=True,
            temp_file=True,
        ),
    ]
    outputs = [
        Output(display_name="Chat Message", name="message", method="message_response"),
    ]

    async def message_response(self) -> Message:
        # Ensure files is a list and filter out empty/None values
        files = self.files if self.files else []
        if files and not isinstance(files, list):
            files = [files]
        # Filter out None/empty values
        files = [f for f in files if f is not None and f != ""]

        # Build endpoints inject caller-controlled file references directly into
        # ChatInput. Resolve and validate local references before the Message can
        # later read them while constructing model attachment content.
        if files:
            settings_service = get_settings_service()
            storage_type = getattr(getattr(settings_service, "settings", None), "storage_type", "local")
            # The storage factory falls back to local storage for unsupported
            # values, so only the explicitly configured S3 backend may bypass
            # filesystem containment.
            if str(storage_type).lower() != "s3" and is_local_file_access_restricted():
                scope_ids = list(component_file_access_scopes(self))
                # Public executions replace graph.flow_id with a per-visitor
                # virtual ID. Only the server-populated source provenance may
                # restore the already-validated public attachment namespace.
                source_flow_id = getattr(self.graph, "source_flow_id", None)
                if source_flow_id:
                    scope_ids.append(source_flow_id)
                for file_path in get_file_paths(files):
                    enforce_local_file_access(file_path, scope_ids=scope_ids)

        session_id = self.session_id or self.graph.session_id or ""
        message = await Message.create(
            text=self.input_value,
            sender=self.sender,
            sender_name=self.sender_name,
            session_id=session_id,
            context_id=self.context_id,
            files=files,
        )
        if session_id and isinstance(message, Message) and self.should_store_message:
            stored_message = await self.send_message(
                message,
            )
            self.message.value = stored_message
            message = stored_message

        self.status = message
        return message

import hashlib

from langchain_astradb import AstraDBVectorStore
from langchain_astradb.utils.astradb import SetupMode
from langchain_chroma import Chroma

from lfx.custom import Component

REFUSAL = (
    "Maaf, pertanyaan itu di luar cakupan rencana Anda. "
    "Silakan tanyakan ke perawat Anda atau hubungi hotline."
)
DEFAULT_DB_PATH = "/home/frxskie/langflow/syncare-review.sqlite3"
DEFAULT_PERSIST_DIR = "/home/frxskie/langflow/syncare-f5-chroma"
DEFAULT_PROTOCOL_DIR = "/home/frxskie/Documents/trackover/protocols"
DEFAULT_ASTRA_COLLECTION = "syncare_f5_kb"
DEFAULT_ASTRA_KEYSPACE = "default_keyspace"
DEFAULT_ASTRA_ENDPOINT_VAR = "ASTRA_DB_API_ENDPOINT"
DEFAULT_ASTRA_TOKEN_VAR = "ASTRA_DB_APPLICATION_TOKEN"
PROTOCOL_FILES = ("hf-aftercare.txt", "medication-safety.txt")
EMBEDDING_MODEL = "models/gemini-embedding-001"
EMBEDDING_DIMENSION = 3072
SENT_SPLIT = re.compile(r"(?<=[.!?])\s+")
PROTOCOL_PROVENANCE = "DRAFT EDUKASI SINTETIS / NON-KLINIS / DEMO SAJA"
APPROVED_PROVENANCE = "approved_plans+audit; persetujuan alur kerja sintetis, BUKAN persetujuan klinis"


def patient_collection_hash(patient_id):
    return hashlib.sha256(patient_id.encode()).hexdigest()[:16]


class SynCareRetriever(Component):
    display_name = "SynCare F5 Patient-Scope Retriever"
    description = (
        "Fail-closed approved-patient scope gate, exact-model patient-scoped "
        "ingest/query (top-4) on Astra DB with Chroma fallback. Read-only "
        "approval lookup; never mutates the review DB."
    )
    inputs = [
        MessageTextInput(name="input_value", display_name="Patient Query JSON", required=True),
        SecretStrInput(name="api_key", display_name="Google Generative AI API Key", required=True, load_from_db=True),
        MessageTextInput(name="db_path", display_name="Review DB Path", value=DEFAULT_DB_PATH, advanced=True),
        MessageTextInput(name="persist_directory", display_name="Chroma Persist Directory", value=DEFAULT_PERSIST_DIR, advanced=True),
        MessageTextInput(name="protocol_directory", display_name="Protocol Directory", value=DEFAULT_PROTOCOL_DIR, advanced=True),
        DropdownInput(
            name="vector_backend",
            display_name="Vector Backend",
            options=["astra", "chroma"],
            value="astra",
            advanced=True,
            info="Vector backend; falls back to Chroma if Astra unavailable",
        ),
        SecretStrInput(
            name="astra_api_endpoint",
            display_name="Astra DB API Endpoint (global variable name)",
            value=DEFAULT_ASTRA_ENDPOINT_VAR,
            required=False,
            advanced=True,
            load_from_db=True,
        ),
        SecretStrInput(
            name="astra_token",
            display_name="Astra DB Application Token (global variable name)",
            value=DEFAULT_ASTRA_TOKEN_VAR,
            required=False,
            advanced=True,
            load_from_db=True,
        ),
        MessageTextInput(
            name="astra_collection",
            display_name="Astra Collection Base Name",
            value=DEFAULT_ASTRA_COLLECTION,
            advanced=True,
        ),
        MessageTextInput(
            name="astra_keyspace",
            display_name="Astra Keyspace / Namespace",
            value=DEFAULT_ASTRA_KEYSPACE,
            advanced=True,
        ),
    ]
    outputs = [
        Output(name="retrieved", display_name="Retrieved Context JSON", method="emit_retrieved", group_outputs=True),
        Output(name="refusal", display_name="Scope Refusal", method="emit_refusal", group_outputs=True),
        Output(name="error", display_name="Fail-Closed Error JSON", method="emit_error", group_outputs=True),
    ]

    def _prepare(self):
        if hasattr(self, "_prepared"):
            return self._prepared
        try:
            raw = self.input_value
            source = json.loads(raw.text if isinstance(raw, Message) else str(raw))
            patient_id = source["patient_id"]
            query = source["query"]
            if not isinstance(patient_id, str) or not patient_id.strip():
                raise ValueError("patient_id required")
            if not isinstance(query, str) or not query.strip():
                raise ValueError("query required")
            row = self._load_approved(patient_id)
            if row is None:
                self._prepared = {"ok": False, "kind": "refusal", "patient_id": patient_id}
                return self._prepared
            embedder = GoogleGenerativeAIEmbeddings(
                model=EMBEDDING_MODEL,
                google_api_key=self.api_key,
            )
            if embedder.model != EMBEDDING_MODEL:
                raise ValueError("Embedding model must be exactly " + EMBEDDING_MODEL)
            plan, approved_at = row
            chunks = self._build_chunks(patient_id, plan, approved_at)
            collection_hash = patient_collection_hash(patient_id)
            collection = "syncare_f5_" + collection_hash
            vector_store, astra_status = self._select_vector_store(
                embedder, patient_id, collection_hash
            )
            self._sync_collection(vector_store, patient_id, chunks, astra_status)
            results = vector_store.similarity_search_with_score(query, k=4, filter={"patient_id": patient_id})
            retrieved = []
            for document, distance in results:
                sentences = [s for s in SENT_SPLIT.split(document.page_content.strip()) if s]
                retrieved.append(
                    {
                        "chunk_id": document.metadata.get("chunk_id", ""),
                        "source": document.metadata.get("source", ""),
                        "approved": bool(document.metadata.get("approved", False)),
                        "provenance": document.metadata.get("provenance", ""),
                        "patient_id": document.metadata.get("patient_id", ""),
                        "distance": distance,
                        "text": document.page_content,
                        "sentences": sentences,
                    }
                )
            units = []
            for chunk in retrieved:
                label = "rencana_disetujui_workflow_sintetis" if chunk["approved"] else "draf_edukasi_tidak_disetujui"
                for number, sentence in enumerate(chunk["sentences"], start=1):
                    units.append(f"{chunk['chunk_id']}#{number} [{label}]: {sentence}")
            self._prepared = {
                "ok": True,
                "patient_id": patient_id,
                "query": query,
                "collection": collection,
                "approved_at": approved_at,
                "retrieved": retrieved,
                "astra_status": astra_status,
                "units_text": "PERTANYAAN PASIEN: "
                + query
                + "\n\nKONTEKS TERKUMPUL (UNIT BUKTI; pilih id apa adanya, jangan mengarang id atau teks):\n"
                + "\n".join(units)
                + '\nJawab HANYA satu JSON: {"scope": "in_scope", "selected_ids": ["<id unit>", ...]} memilih '
                'unit persis di atas yang menjawab pertanyaan, atau {"scope": "out_of_scope", "selected_ids": []} '
                "jika pertanyaan tidak dapat dijawab HANYA dari unit di atas. Jangan menambahkan teks lain.",
            }
        except Exception as exc:  # fail closed, never mask as refusal
            self._prepared = {
                "ok": False,
                "kind": "error",
                "error": "retrieval_failed",
                "reason": f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}",
            }
        return self._prepared

    @staticmethod
    def _resolved_secret(value):
        """Non-empty plain string -> resolved credential; anything else -> None."""
        if value is None:
            return None
        text = value.get_secret_value() if hasattr(value, "get_secret_value") else value
        if isinstance(text, str) and text.strip():
            return text
        return None

    def _select_vector_store(self, embedder, patient_id, collection_hash):
        """Pick Astra or Chroma. Returns (vector_store, astra_status dict)."""
        requested = "astra" if getattr(self, "vector_backend", "chroma") == "astra" else "chroma"
        astra_status = {"backend_requested": requested, "backend_used": requested}
        endpoint = self._resolved_secret(getattr(self, "astra_api_endpoint", None))
        token = self._resolved_secret(getattr(self, "astra_token", None))
        if requested != "astra" or not endpoint or not token:
            astra_status["backend_used"] = "chroma"
            if requested == "astra":
                if not endpoint:
                    astra_status["fallback_reason"] = "astra_api_endpoint not resolvable (global variable missing/empty); fallback_to_env_var=True so field builds as None"
                else:
                    astra_status["fallback_reason"] = "astra_token not resolvable (global variable missing/empty); fallback_to_env_var=True so field builds as None"
            astra_status["chroma_collection"] = "syncare_f5_" + collection_hash
            astra_status["chroma_persist_directory"] = self.persist_directory
            return Chroma(
                collection_name="syncare_f5_" + collection_hash,
                embedding_function=embedder,
                persist_directory=self.persist_directory,
                **chroma_langchain_collection_kwargs(),
            ), astra_status
        base = self.astra_collection.rstrip("_") if isinstance(self.astra_collection, str) and self.astra_collection.strip() else DEFAULT_ASTRA_COLLECTION
        if base.endswith(collection_hash):
            astra_collection = base
        else:
            astra_collection = base + "_" + collection_hash
        astra_status["astra_collection"] = astra_collection
        astra_status["astra_keyspace"] = self.astra_keyspace
        try:
            vector_store = AstraDBVectorStore(
                collection_name=astra_collection,
                embedding=embedder,
                token=token,
                api_endpoint=endpoint,
                namespace=self.astra_keyspace,
                metric="cosine",
                setup_mode=SetupMode.SYNC,
            )
            dimension = vector_store.embedding_dimension
            if dimension != EMBEDDING_DIMENSION:
                raise ValueError(
                    f"astra collection dimension mismatch: got {dimension}, expected {EMBEDDING_DIMENSION}"
                )
            astra_status["dimension_choice"] = f"dimension {EMBEDDING_DIMENSION} (cosine) confirmed on '{astra_collection}'"
            return vector_store, astra_status
        except Exception as exc:
            reason = f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}"
            text = reason.lower()
            if "dimension" in text or "mismatch" in text or "existing collection" in text:
                alt_collection = astra_collection if astra_collection.endswith("_d3072") else astra_collection + "_d3072"
                try:
                    vector_store = AstraDBVectorStore(
                        collection_name=alt_collection,
                        embedding=embedder,
                        token=token,
                        api_endpoint=endpoint,
                        namespace=self.astra_keyspace,
                        metric="cosine",
                        setup_mode=SetupMode.SYNC,
                    )
                    dimension = vector_store.embedding_dimension
                    if dimension != EMBEDDING_DIMENSION:
                        raise ValueError(
                            f"astra collection dimension mismatch after recreate: got {dimension}, expected {EMBEDDING_DIMENSION}"
                        )
                    astra_status["astra_collection"] = alt_collection
                    astra_status["dimension_choice"] = f"dimension mismatch on '{astra_collection}'; recreated once as '{alt_collection}' with dimension {EMBEDDING_DIMENSION} (cosine)"
                    return vector_store, astra_status
                except Exception as retry_exc:
                    astra_status["backend_used"] = "chroma"
                    astra_status["fallback_reason"] = f"dimension-recreate as {alt_collection} failed -> {type(retry_exc).__name__}: {retry_exc} (initial: {reason})"
                    astra_status["chroma_collection"] = "syncare_f5_" + collection_hash
                    astra_status["chroma_persist_directory"] = self.persist_directory
                    return Chroma(
                        collection_name="syncare_f5_" + collection_hash,
                        embedding_function=embedder,
                        persist_directory=self.persist_directory,
                        **chroma_langchain_collection_kwargs(),
                    ), astra_status
            astra_status["backend_used"] = "chroma"
            astra_status["fallback_reason"] = reason
            astra_status["chroma_collection"] = "syncare_f5_" + collection_hash
            astra_status["chroma_persist_directory"] = self.persist_directory
            return Chroma(
                collection_name="syncare_f5_" + collection_hash,
                embedding_function=embedder,
                persist_directory=self.persist_directory,
                **chroma_langchain_collection_kwargs(),
            ), astra_status

    def _load_approved(self, patient_id):
        connection = sqlite3.connect("file:" + self.db_path + "?mode=ro", uri=True)
        try:
            row = connection.execute(
                "SELECT plan_json, approved_at FROM approved_plans "
                "WHERE json_extract(plan_json, '$.patient_id') = ? "
                "ORDER BY approved_at DESC, rowid DESC LIMIT 1",
                (patient_id,),
            ).fetchone()
            if row is None:
                return None
            provenance = connection.execute(
                "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM audit_log WHERE action = 'Approve' AND timestamp = ? "
                "AND json_extract(payload, '$.plan_json.patient_id') = ?",
                (row[1], patient_id),
            ).fetchone()[0]
            if provenance < 1:
                return None
            return json.loads(row[0]), row[1]
        finally:
            connection.close()

    def _build_chunks(self, patient_id, plan, approved_at):
        chunks = []

        def add(text, source, approved, chunk_id, provenance):
            chunks.append(
                {
                    "id": chunk_id,
                    "text": text,
                    "source": source,
                    "approved": approved,
                    "provenance": provenance,
                    "approved_at": approved_at if approved else "",
                    "patient_id": patient_id,
                }
            )

        add(plan["plan_text"], "approved_plan.plan_text", True, patient_id + ":plan_text", APPROVED_PROVENANCE)
        episode = plan["source_input"]["f1_scored_output"]["episode"]
        for index, instruction in enumerate(episode.get("instructions") or []):
            add(instruction, "approved_plan.instructions", True, f"{patient_id}:instruction:{index}", APPROVED_PROVENANCE)
        for index, medication in enumerate(episode.get("medications") or []):
            add(medication, "approved_plan.medications", True, f"{patient_id}:medication:{index}", APPROVED_PROVENANCE)
        for index, activity in enumerate(plan.get("care_intensity") or []):
            add(activity, "approved_plan.care_intensity", True, f"{patient_id}:care_intensity:{index}", APPROVED_PROVENANCE)
        for filename in PROTOCOL_FILES:
            slug = filename.rsplit(".", 1)[0]
            with open(self.protocol_directory.rstrip("/") + "/" + filename, encoding="utf-8") as handle:
                raw = handle.read()
            for index, section in enumerate(part for part in re.split(r"\n\s*\n", raw) if part.strip()):
                add(section.strip(), "protocol:" + slug, False, f"{slug}:section:{index}", PROTOCOL_PROVENANCE)
        return chunks

    @staticmethod
    def _metadata(chunk):
        return {
            "patient_id": chunk["patient_id"],
            "chunk_id": chunk["id"],
            "source": chunk["source"],
            "approved": chunk["approved"],
            "provenance": chunk["provenance"],
            "approved_at": chunk["approved_at"],
        }

    @staticmethod
    def _sync_collection(vector_store, patient_id, chunks, astra_status):
        if astra_status.get("backend_used") == "astra":
            try:
                vector_store.delete_by_metadata_filter(filter={"patient_id": patient_id})
            except Exception as sync_exc:
                raise RuntimeError(
                    "astra_delete_by_metadata_filter_failed: "
                    f"{type(sync_exc).__name__}: {sync_exc}"
                ) from sync_exc
            if chunks:
                vector_store.add_documents(
                    [Document(page_content=chunk["text"], metadata=SynCareRetriever._metadata(chunk)) for chunk in chunks],
                    ids=[chunk["id"] for chunk in chunks],
                )
            return
        existing = vector_store.get(include=["documents", "metadatas"])
        by_id = {}
        for existing_id, document, metadata in zip(
            list(existing.get("ids") or []),
            list(existing.get("documents") or []),
            list(existing.get("metadatas") or []),
        ):
            by_id[existing_id] = (document, metadata or {})
        desired = {chunk["id"]: chunk for chunk in chunks}
        to_delete = [
            existing_id
            for existing_id, (document, metadata) in by_id.items()
            if existing_id not in desired
            or document != desired[existing_id]["text"]
            or metadata != SynCareRetriever._metadata(desired[existing_id])
        ]
        if to_delete:
            vector_store.delete(ids=to_delete)
        to_add = [chunk for chunk_id, chunk in desired.items() if chunk_id not in by_id or chunk_id in to_delete]
        if to_add:
            vector_store.add_documents(
                [Document(page_content=chunk["text"], metadata=SynCareRetriever._metadata(chunk)) for chunk in to_add],
                ids=[chunk["id"] for chunk in to_add],
            )

    def _exclude(self, output):
        self.stop(output)
        self.graph.exclude_branch_conditionally(self._id, output_name=output)

    def emit_retrieved(self) -> Message:
        result = self._prepare()
        if not result["ok"]:
            self._exclude("retrieved")
            return Message(text="")
        self._exclude("refusal")
        self._exclude("error")
        payload = {
            "patient_id": result["patient_id"],
            "collection": result["collection"],
            "embedding_model": EMBEDDING_MODEL,
            "k": 4,
            "query": result["query"],
            "retrieved": result["retrieved"],
            "units_text": result["units_text"],
            "vector_backend": result["astra_status"].get("backend_used"),
            "astra_status": result["astra_status"],
        }
        return Message(text=json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False))

    def emit_refusal(self) -> Message:
        result = self._prepare()
        if result["ok"] or result.get("kind") != "refusal":
            self._exclude("refusal")
            return Message(text="")
        self._exclude("retrieved")
        self._exclude("error")
        return Message(text=REFUSAL)

    def emit_error(self) -> Message:
        result = self._prepare()
        if result["ok"] or result.get("kind") != "error":
            self._exclude("error")
            return Message(text="")
        self._exclude("retrieved")
        self._exclude("refusal")
        return Message(text=json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False))

            raise ValueError(msg)
        if isinstance(self.input_value, list) and not all(
            isinstance(item, Message | Data | DataFrame | str) for item in self.input_value
        ):
            invalid_types = [
                type(item).__name__
                for item in self.input_value
                if not isinstance(item, Message | Data | DataFrame | str)
            ]
            msg = f"Expected Data or DataFrame or Message or str, got {invalid_types}"
            raise TypeError(msg)
        if not isinstance(
            self.input_value,
            Message | Data | DataFrame | str | list | Generator | type(None),
        ):
            type_name = type(self.input_value).__name__
            msg = f"Expected Data or DataFrame or Message or str, Generator or None, got {type_name}"
            raise TypeError(msg)

    def convert_to_string(self) -> str | Generator[Any, None, None]:
        """Convert input data to string with proper error handling."""
        self._validate_input()
        if isinstance(self.input_value, list):
            clean_data: bool = getattr(self, "clean_data", False)
            return "\n".join([safe_convert(item, clean_data=clean_data) for item in self.input_value])
        if isinstance(self.input_value, Generator):
            return self.input_value
        return safe_convert(self.input_value)
